1269|    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
1270|    for member in shared soul; do
1271|        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
1272|    done
1273|    for member in memory rules skills user; do
1274|        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
1275|    done
1276|    seed_write_hostname
1277|    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
1278|    seed_instance
1279|    seed_mount_guest
1280|    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
1281|    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
1282|}
1283|seed_mode() (
1284|    set -eu
1285|    umask 077
1286|    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
1287|    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
1288|    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
1289|    mode=$1 seed_name=$2
1290|    seed_allow_running=false
1291|    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
1292|    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
1293|    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
1294|    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
1295|    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
1296|    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
1297|    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
1298|    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
1299|    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
1300|    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
1301|    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
1302|    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
1303|    seed_verify_source
1304|    seed_no_direct_mount
1305|    case "$mode" in
1306|    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
1307|    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
1308|    seed-lungs)
1309|        seed_load
1310|        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
1311|            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
1312|        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
1313|        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
1314|        seed_mount_guest
1315|        seed_lungs
1316|        ;;
1317|    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
1318|        seed_load
1319|        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
1320|            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
1321|        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
1322|        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
1323|        seed_mount_guest
1324|        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
1325|        ;;
1326|    seed-up)
1327|        seed_load
1328|        seed_attach
1329|        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
1330|            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
1331|            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
1332|        fi
1333|        seed_mount_guest
1334|        ;;
1335|    seed-down)
1336|        seed_load
1337|        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
1338|        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
1339|        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
1340|            seed_mount_guest
1341|            seed_unlungs
1342|            seed_unmount_guest
1343|        fi
1344|        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
1345|        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
1346|        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
1347|        seed_view= leaf_loop=
1348|        seed_record_loops
1349|        ;;
1350|    esac
1351|)
1352|
1353|command=${1:-status}
1354|[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift
1355|case $command in
1356|seed-readonly)
1357|    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-readonly"; exit 2; }
1358|    seed_readonly
1359|    ;;
1360|seed-profile)
1361|    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-profile"; exit 2; }
1362|    seed_profile
1363|    ;;
1364|seed-preflight)
1365|    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
1366|    seed_preflight
1367|    ;;
1368|seed-inspect)
1369|    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-inspect NAME"; exit 2; }
1370|    seed_inspect "$1"
1371|    ;;
1372|seed-create)
1373|    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }
1374|    seed_mode seed-create "$@"
1375|    ;;
1376|seed-rename)
1377|    [ "$#" -eq 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID"; exit 2; }
1378|    seed_mode seed-rename "$@"
1379|    ;;
1380|seed-enable-boot)
1381|    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] && [ "$#" -le 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false]"; exit 2; }
1382|    case "${2:-true}" in true|false) ;; *) log "boot start policy must be true or false"; exit 2 ;; esac
1383|    seed_mode seed-enable-boot "$1" "${2:-true}"
1384|    ;;
1385|seed-up|seed-down|seed-check|seed-lungs)
1386|    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
1387|    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
1388|    ;;
1389|up)
1390|    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)
1391|    # An empty inventory needs no lower mount or seed validation. In particular,
1392|    # application bootstrap must work before the first identity is provisioned.
1393|    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "no legacy identity roots to restore"; exit 0; }
1394|    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
1395|    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
1396|    failed=0
1397|    for session in "$@"; do
1398|        up_one "$session" || failed=$((failed + 1))
1399|    done
1400|    if [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
1401|        log "$failed identity(ies) did not come up"
1402|        exit 1
1403|    fi
1404|    exit 0
1405|    ;;
1406|down)
1407|    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "name the session(s) to stop"; exit 2; }
1408|    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
1409|    ;;
1410|status) status ;;
1411|create)
1412|    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] || { log "name the session to create"; exit 2; }
1413|    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
1414|    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
1415|    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
1416|    ;;
1417|*)
1418|    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
1419|    exit 2
1420|    ;;
1421|esac","total_lines":1421,"file_size":80540,"truncated":false,"is_binary":false,"is_image":false,"not_found":false}

{"content":"1|#!/bin/sh
2|# Host storage owner: remount/receive existing GPT members, never mint/start.
3|set -eu
4|fail() { printf 'restore-chatbot-root: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
5|check_only=false
6|if [ "${1:-}" = --check ]; then check_only=true; shift; fi
7|[ "$#" -le 1 ] || fail 'usage: restore-chatbot-root [--check] [NAME]'
8|name=${1:-3tchedChatbot}
9|printf '%s' "$name" | grep -Eq '^(3tchedChatbot|ID-[1-9][0-9]*)$' && [ "${#name}" -le 63 ] || fail 'invalid chatbot selector'
10|# A boot opt-in and native key match cannot establish durable name allocation.
11|[ "$name" = 3tchedChatbot ] || fail 'numbered restoration blocked: canonical identity-owner name/UUID/session/key receipt contract is not integrated'
12|[ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || fail 'host root required'
13|sid=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
14|key=[REDACTED:opaque-base64]
15|pool=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool
16|receipt=$pool/.provisioning/$name.boot.json
17|binding=$pool/.provisioning/$name.incus.json
18|disk=$pool/.provisioning/$name.json
19|root=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots/containers/$name/rootfs
20|view=$pool/.mounts/$name/root-view
21|seed_layer=$pool/.mounts/$name/seed-layer
22|upgrade_layer=$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade-layer
23|readback() { timeout --kill-after=5s 30s "$@"; }
24|secure_path() (
25|    path=$1
26|    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$path")" = "$path" ] || fail "noncanonical path: $path"
27|    while :; do
28|        [ ! -L "$path" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$path")" = 0 ] &&
29|            [ $((0$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022)) -eq 0 ] || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"
30|        [ "$path" != / ] || break
31|        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
32|    done
33|)
34|[ "$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSROOT)" = /@3tched-leaf-pool ] || fail 'leaf pool not mounted'
35|for file in "$receipt" "$binding" "$disk"; do
36|    secure_path "$file"
37|    [ -f "$file" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$file")" = 0:0:600 ] || fail "unsafe preparation receipt: $file"
38|done
39|jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" '
40|    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and
41|    .identity_registered==true and .restore_existing_pair==true
42|' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot boot attestation differs'
43|# The boot opt-in is not identity authority. Match the host preparation's
44|# existing native UUID/session/key and storage paths before any mount action.
45|jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg root "$root" --arg view "$view" '
46|    .version==1 and .name==$name and .session_id==$sid and .phase=="root-bound" and
47|    .root_bound==true and .root_view_readonly==true and .upgrade_paired==true and
48|    .threetched_root==$root and .root_view==$view and .instance.name==$name and .instance.type=="container" and
49|    .instance.config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .instance.config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
50|    (.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))
51|' "$binding" >/dev/null || fail 'chatbot preparation pins differ'
52|uuid=$(jq -er '.instance.config["volatile.uuid"]' "$binding")
53|jq -e --arg uuid "$uuid" '
54|    (has("instance_uuid")|not) or .instance_uuid==$uuid
55|' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'boot native UUID differs'
56|jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg image "$pool/$name.img" --arg root "$pool/.mounts/$name/root" \
57|    --arg upgrade "$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade" '
58|    .name==$name and .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1" and .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and
59|    .filesystem_prepared==true and .image==$image and .root_mount==$root and .upgrade_mount==$upgrade
60|' "$disk" >/dev/null || fail 'disk preparation pins differ'
61|image=$pool/$name.img
62|secure_path "$image"
63|[ -f "$image" ] && [ "$(stat -c %i "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_inode "$disk")" ] &&
64|    [ "$(stat -c %s "$image")" = "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$disk")" ] || fail 'image pins differ'
65|instance=$(readback incus --force-local query "/1.0/instances/$name") || fail 'native instance readback failed'
66|printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$sid" --arg key "$key" --arg uuid "$uuid" '
67|    .name==$name and .type=="container" and .config["volatile.uuid"]==$uuid and
68|    .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid and .config["user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key"]==$key and
69|    .config["security.privileged"]=="false" and .config["security.protection.shift"]=="true" and
70|    .config["boot.autostart"]=="false" and .profiles==["3tched-lungs"] and
71|    .devices.root.type=="disk" and .devices.root.path=="/" and .devices.root.pool=="identity-roots" and
72|    ((.status=="Stopped" and .status_code==102) or (.status=="Running" and .status_code==103))
73|' >/dev/null || fail 'native chatbot UUID/session/key/policy differs'
74|state=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -er .status)
75|# Select the activated closure deliberately. When invoked from a source or
76|# received release, use that helper's sibling; never fall through to base copies.
77|self=$(realpath -e -- "$0") || fail 'cannot resolve restore helper'
78|helper_dir=$(dirname -- "$self")
79|case "$helper_dir" in
80|    /usr/local/libexec/3tched)
81|        helper_dir=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers ;;
82|esac
83|sync_helper=$helper_dir/sync-instance-upgrade
84|case "$self" in
85|    */deploy/runit/libexec-3tched/restore-chatbot-root)
86|        sync_helper=$helper_dir/../../scripts/sync-instance-upgrade.sh ;;
87|esac
88|sync_helper=$(realpath -e -- "${OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER:-$sync_helper}") || fail 'selected sync helper absent'
89|secure_path "$sync_helper"
90|[ -f "$sync_helper" ] && [ -x "$sync_helper" ] || fail 'selected sync helper not executable'
91|if [ "$state" = Running ]; then
92|    # A service restart observes only; it must not replace a running guest's lowers.
93|    [ "$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FSTYPE)" = overlay ] || fail 'running root is not overlay'
94|    options=$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o FS-OPTIONS) || fail 'cannot inspect running root'
95|    case ",$options," in *,"lowerdir=$upgrade_layer:$seed_layer",*) ;; *) fail 'running root lower pins differ' ;; esac
96|    case ",$(readback findmnt -rn -M "$root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in *,ro,*) ;; *) fail 'running root is not read-only' ;; esac
97|    exit 0
98|fi
99|[ "$check_only" != true ] || exit 0
100|exec "$sync_helper" boot "$name"","total_lines":100,"file_size":6122,"truncated":false,"is_binary":false,"is_image":false,"not_found":false}

{"content":"1|#!/bin/sh
2|# Restore only receipt-selected existing roots after Incus readiness. Numbered
3|# names are selectors, never identity authority. Preflight all boot selections
4|# before restoring anything; conflicting logical identities fail closed.
5|# This base-owned service is not installed/enabled by application activation.
6|exec 2>&1
7|rm -f /run/opdbus/runit-ready/identity-roots
8|fail() { printf 'identity-roots: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
9|secure_path() (
10|    path=$1
11|    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$path")" = "$path" ] || fail "noncanonical path: $path"
12|    while :; do
13|        [ ! -L "$path" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$path")" = 0 ] &&
14|            [ $((0$(stat -c %a -- "$path") & 022)) -eq 0 ] || fail "unsafe owner/mode: $path"
15|        [ "$path" != / ] || break
16|        path=$(dirname -- "$path")
17|    done
18|)
19|private_receipt() {
20|    secure_path "$1" || return 1
21|    [ -f "$1" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a "$1")" = 0:0:600 ]
22|}
23|wait_dep() {
24|    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
25|    i=0
26|    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
27|        i=$((i + 1))
28|        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && fail "dependency $1 not ready after 90s"
29|        sleep 1
30|    done
31|}
32|wait_dep incus
33|i=0
34|until incus info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
35|    i=$((i + 1))
36|    [ "$i" -lt 60 ] || fail 'incusd API not ready'
37|    sleep 1
38|done
39|# Deliberate release-owned dependency selection; a partial/broken activated
40|# closure is an error, not permission to execute an older base helper.
41|if [ "${OP_IDENTITY_HELPER_DIR+x}" = x ]; then
42|    helper_dir=$OP_IDENTITY_HELPER_DIR
43|else
44|    helper_dir=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers
45|fi
46|helper_dir=$(realpath -e -- "$helper_dir") || fail 'selected helper directory absent'
47|secure_path "$helper_dir" || exit 1
48|for dependency in op-identity-root op-identity-image restore-chatbot-root sync-instance-upgrade runit-ready-signal; do
49|    secure_path "$helper_dir/$dependency" || exit 1
50|    [ -f "$helper_dir/$dependency" ] && [ -x "$helper_dir/$dependency" ] || fail "selected helper unavailable: $dependency"
51|done
52|helper=$helper_dir/op-identity-root
53|restore_helper=$helper_dir/restore-chatbot-root
54|# Keep the entire root-helper chain in the selected closure.
55|OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=$helper_dir/op-identity-image
56|OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER=$helper_dir/sync-instance-upgrade
57|export OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER OP_SYNC_INSTANCE_UPGRADE_HELPER
58|chatbot_session=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
59|physical=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
60|legacy=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
61|gpt_present=0
62|gpt_name=
63|physical_present=0
64|physical_names=
65|selected_sessions='|'
66|# GPT boot receipts attest completed adoption; restore --check verifies exact
67|# native UUID/session/key plus the corresponding private disk/root receipts.
68|# Never execute restoration while another receipt could name the same chatbot.
69|for receipt in /var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/.provisioning/*.boot.json; do
70|    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
71|    gpt_present=1
72|    private_receipt "$receipt" || fail "unsafe GPT boot receipt: $receipt"
73|    name=$(basename "$receipt" .boot.json)
74|    [ -z "$gpt_name" ] || fail 'multiple GPT chatbot boot receipts; reconcile before restoration'
75|    "$restore_helper" --check "$name" || fail "invalid GPT chatbot boot receipt: $name"
76|    gpt_name=$name
77|    selected_sessions="$selected_sessions$chatbot_session|"
78|done
79|for receipt in "$physical"/*/state.json; do
80|    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
81|    physical_present=1
82|    name=$(basename "$(dirname "$receipt")")
83|    marker=$physical/$name/boot-ready.json
84|    if [ ! -e "$marker" ] && [ ! -L "$marker" ]; then
85|        echo "physical seed $name: no authoritative-completion boot opt-in; skipped"
86|        continue
87|    fi
88|    private_receipt "$receipt" && private_receipt "$marker" || fail "unsafe physical boot receipts: $name"
89|    # Keep existing canonical UUID roots and the legacy chatbot alias. Reject
90|    # numbered selections before any restoration until the identity owner's
91|    # durable name/UUID/session/key receipt contract is integrated.
92|    jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg sid "$chatbot_session" '
93|        .version==1 and .layout=="shared-partition-siblings-v2" and .name==$name and .phase=="ready" and
94|        (.session|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$")) and
95|        (.instance_uuid|type=="string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$")) and
96|        (.session==$name or (.session==$sid and $name=="3tchedChatbot"))
97|    ' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail "invalid/incomplete physical boot receipt: $name"
98|    policy=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot|select(type=="boolean")|tostring' "$marker") || fail "invalid physical boot policy: $name"
99|    expected=$(jq -cS --argjson start "$policy" '{version,layout,image,members,persist,name,session,instance_uuid,root,seed_fsid,seed_generation,sprout_fsid,leaf,leaf_inode,leaf_size,start_on_boot:$start}' "$receipt") || fail "invalid storage pins: $name"
100|    actual=$(jq -cS . "$marker") || fail "invalid boot marker: $name"
101|    [ "$expected" = "$actual" ] || fail "physical boot/storage pins differ: $name"
102|    session=$(jq -er .session "$receipt") || fail "missing physical session: $name"
103|    case "$selected_sessions" in
104|        *"|$session|"*) fail "conflicting boot receipts for logical identity $session; no roots restored" ;;
105|    esac
106|    selected_sessions="$selected_sessions$session|"
107|    physical_names="$physical_names $name"
108|done
109|failed=0
110|if [ -n "$gpt_name" ]; then
111|    "$restore_helper" "$gpt_name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
112|fi
113|seed_readonly_ready=0
114|for name in $physical_names; do
115|    receipt=$physical/$name/state.json
116|    marker=$physical/$name/boot-ready.json
117|    start_on_boot=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot|select(type=="boolean")|tostring' "$marker") || fail "invalid boot policy: $name"
118|    # The helper checks the complete boot/storage marker, native UUID and
119|    # session/key binding again under its lifecycle lock before touching roots.
120|    if [ "$seed_readonly_ready" -eq 0 ]; then
121|        "$helper" seed-readonly || fail 'physical seed read-only enforcement failed'
122|        seed_readonly_ready=1
123|    fi
124|    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$name/state" | jq -er '.status') || state=unknown
125|    case "$state" in
126|        Running)
127|            if "$helper" seed-check "$name"; then
128|                "$helper" seed-lungs "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
129|            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
130|            ;;
131|        Stopped)
132|            if "$helper" seed-up "$name" && "$helper" seed-lungs "$name"; then
133|                if [ "$start_on_boot" = true ]; then incus start "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
134|                else echo "physical seed $name: storage restored; boot start disabled"; fi
135|            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
136|            ;;
137|        *) echo "physical seed $name: unsupported native status $state" >&2
138|            failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
139|    esac
140|done
141|if [ "$physical_present" -eq 1 ] || [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
142|    # Never select legacy `up`: directly mounting the same seed conflicts with
143|    # retained sprouts even when another identity's root failed restoration.
144|    for image in "$legacy"/*/identity.img; do
145|        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
146|        name=$(basename "$(dirname "$image")")
147|        case "$selected_sessions" in
148|            *"|$name|"*) echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by selected boot receipt"; continue ;;
149|        esac
150|        if [ "$name" = 3tchedChatbot ] && [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
151|            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by GPT boot receipt"
152|        elif [ -e "$physical/$name/state.json" ] || [ -L "$physical/$name/state.json" ]; then
153|            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by physical seed receipt"
154|        else
155|            echo "legacy identity $name: migration or independent lower required; shared seed direct mount suppressed" >&2
156|            failed=$((failed + 1))
157|        fi
158|    done
159|else
160|    "$helper" up || failed=$((failed + 1))
161|    "$helper" status || failed=$((failed + 1))
162|fi
163|[ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || fail "$failed identity root startup check(s) failed"

{"content":"1|#!/bin/sh
2|# op-identity-root — bring identities up from their own devices (OD-86).
3|# Installed by the host storage owner at /usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root
4|# and run at boot by the identity-roots runit service after incus.
5|#
6|# Legacy commands use identity.img plus overlay roots. Explicit seed-* commands
7|# instead use one shared physical SEED partition with a private writable leaf;
8|# their root-only descriptors are storage receipts, never identity authority.
9|# Legacy roots use /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities/<session>/identity.img
10|# holding a btrfs filesystem labelled identity-<session>. For each this script
11|#
12|#   1) attaches and mounts the device at <identity>/device,
13|#   2) mounts the container root as overlay(Raccoon, device/upper),
14|#   3) mounts the identity's lungs (3tchedFS with a call file per method),
15|#   4) starts the Incus container named <session>.
16|#
17|# The shared lower layer is the read-only Raccoon partition, shown through an
18|# idmapped view so Incus never shifts (chowns) the root into the upper layer.
19|# A failure stays inside that identity: the script logs it and moves on, and
20|# it never gates incusd or any service container.
21|#
22|# Usage:
23|#   sudo op-identity-root up [<session>...]     # default: every identity
24|#   sudo op-identity-root down <session>...
25|#   sudo op-identity-root status
26|#   sudo ARCHIVE_EXISTING=1 op-identity-root create <session> [size]
27|#                                  # give an existing identity a device, fresh on Raccoon
28|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES
29|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-preflight # read-only source/helper readiness
30|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-profile # prepare exact shared lungs Incus profile
31|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-inspect NAME # read-only retained receipt/guidance
32|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-up NAME   # mount only; deliberately start separately
33|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-down NAME # stopped candidate required; retain leaf
34|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID # after seed-down and Incus rename
35|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-check NAME # observe mounted root, including Running
36|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-lungs NAME # host-private mount; verify only if Running
37|#   sudo op-identity-root seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false] # AFTER authoritative attach/Get proof
38|#
39|# Environment overrides (defaults shown):
40|#   RACCOON_UUID=b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601
41|#   SEEDS=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds            read-only Raccoon mount (fstab)
42|#   SEEDS_IDMAP=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap
43|#   IDMAP='b:0:1000000:1000000000'         must match the containers' idmap
44|#   IDENTITIES=/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities
45|#   POOL=identity-roots                    Incus dir pool for identity roots
46|#   LUNGS_RUN=/run/opdbus-lungs
47|#   LUNGS_SOCKET=/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock    the bridge's shared lungs socket
48|#   THREETCHED_FS=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/3tched-fs    the host release binary
49|#   OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=<selected helper sibling>/op-identity-image
50|set -u
51|
52|RACCOON_UUID=${RACCOON_UUID:-b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601}
53|SEEDS=${SEEDS:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds}
54|SEEDS_IDMAP=${SEEDS_IDMAP:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap}
55|IDMAP=${IDMAP:-b:0:1000000:1000000000}
56|IDENTITIES=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
57|POOL=${POOL:-identity-roots}
58|POOL_PATH=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/$POOL/containers
59|LUNGS_RUN=${LUNGS_RUN:-/run/opdbus-lungs}
60|LUNGS_SOCKET=${LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}

Completed source integration in all seven owned files. Shell parsing passed for each; no Cargo, tests, runtime actions or deployment.

- `--prepare-container --operation-id UUID` persists intent before canonical invocation, stores assigned `ID-N`/UUID/caller/request/result, prints assigned name to stdout. Same-operation replay only; replacement operation IDs fail closed.
- Numbered disk stages, bind, adoption preparation and sync require canonical completed-operation replay through new `op-identity-root verify-prepared-name ID-N`, plus native UUID/session/key verification.
- `--system LABEL --operation-id UUID` omits native name, consumes assigned name, persists creation/start intents and verifies native readback.
- Removed legacy subscriber direct-init implementation. Existing `3tchedChatbot` and canonical-UUID root paths remain supported.
- Preserved fstab, storage receipt, sync restoration and boot guards.

**Parent compatibility:** numbered bind requires **no further device/config mutation** beyond existing provider-owned `volatile.last_state.idmap`. Exact canonical FUSE device is required; forbidden host devices or missing FUSE fail closed, without mutation fallback.

**Remaining limitation:** numbered early-boot restoration intentionally fails closed; online replay is not introduced as a circular boot dependency. Offline authoritative binding validation remains unavailable.

Usage:
```sh
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --prepare-container --operation-id UUID
# Use returned ID-N:
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --prepare-disk ID-N
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --prepare-filesystems ID-N --seed-device /dev/disk/by-uuid/UUID
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --pair-upgrade ID-N
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --bind-root ID-N
sudo ./deploy/scripts/provision-workspace-subscriber.sh --prepare-adoption ID-N
```
Adoption helper publishes the pinned plan/arguments; it does not itself adopt or start.
